title: Perception is an activity of the whole animal, not a process in the brain

statements.text: Perception depends on what happens in the brain, and there may be internal representations there, but perception is not a process in the brain. It is skillful activity on the part of the animal as a whole.

sources.quote: What perception is, however, is not a process in the brain, but a kind of skillful activity on the part of the animal as a whole.
